chronicles.excerpt: Dex faces his oldest mystery, the orange shape beyond the glass in this humorous short story about rivalry, territory, and the unexpected.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Dex the Bearded Dragon: The Sun, the Glass, and the Cricket That Got Away
chronicles.excerpt: Meet Dex: a bearded dragon with opinions, ambitions, and a cricket problem. This bearded dragon short story kicks off a charming, witty animal fiction series.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Dex the Bearded Dragon: The Terrarium 500 (Part 15)
chronicles.excerpt: The vacuum cleaner's roar sends Dex into a dream where he's the reigning champion of an underground racetrack, and the only thing standing between him and the trophy is a hamster with entirely too much energy.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Dex the Bearded Dragon: The Twelfth Day (Part 4)
chronicles.excerpt: Dex has settled into an eleven-day ritual with the cat beyond the glass, until the twelfth day arrives and the windowsill stays empty, in this quietly funny short story about routine, absence, and what a king starts counting on.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Dex the Bearded Dragon: The Waiting Room (Part 9)
chronicles.excerpt: Dex is carried off in his travel tub for a checkup and lands in a vet's waiting room ruled by a loudly opinionated parrot and a magnificently put-upon chinchilla, in this ensemble comedy short story about dignity, chaos, and discovering the world is bigger than the glass.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Dex the Bearded Dragon: What the Glass Was For (Part 7)
chronicles.excerpt: When a window is left open a crack on a warm afternoon, Dex and Whiskey come closer to real contact than four years of glass-pressed friendship ever allowed, and Dex learns what the boundary between them was truly protecting all along.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: First Flight (Part 4)
chronicles.excerpt: Dozing in his hutch on a hot afternoon, Otis dreams that he can fly, rising above the only garden he's ever known to see its whole shape, and the neighborhood beyond it, for the first time.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: High Noon at Clover Gulch (Part 16)
chronicles.excerpt: A hot, dry week leaves only one lush patch of clover standing in the whole garden, and Otis dreams himself into a dusty frontier town, defending it from a stranger who rides in at high noon.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: Otis Goes Downtown (Part 14)
chronicles.excerpt: A grocery bag full of unfamiliar city smells sends Otis into a dream where he escapes his garden entirely and discovers a whole downtown just waiting to be claimed, one fruit stand at a time.

chronicles.title: The Bark and the Gap (Part 3)
chronicles.excerpt: Otis spends eleven days building a rival worthy of his fence line, then finds the gap in the boards and discovers the truth is a lot smaller than the legend he invented.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Costume (Part 9)
chronicles.excerpt: Katie dresses Otis in a flower crown for the neighborhood spring fair, and the house rabbit spends the whole afternoon torn between righteous indignation and undisguised delight at the attention.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Day at the Park (Part 11)
chronicles.excerpt: Katie takes Otis to a public park for the first time, where a parade of off-leash dogs, many times his size and thrilled to meet him, forces the self-assured rabbit to figure out what territorial confidence even means in the open grass.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Day He Decided the Garden Belonged to Him
chronicles.excerpt: Follow along in this Otis the bunny story, a charming short fiction about one determined rabbit navigating the big drama hiding in very small moments.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The First Afternoon (Part 13)
chronicles.excerpt: A particular slant of afternoon light sends Otis back to his very first day in the garden, back before the lettuce bed, the hydrangea's shade, and the clover along the fence line were his to claim. What he finds waiting there is not embarrassment but fondness for the smaller, uncertain rabbit he used to be.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Foster (Part 12)
chronicles.excerpt: When Katie agrees to foster a clumsy baby rabbit for the rescue, Otis finds his meticulously defended garden invaded, and discovers, much to his own irritation, that he is better at looking after someone than he ever intended to be.

chronicles.title: The Garden and the Squirrel (Part 2)
chronicles.excerpt: A squirrel raids Otis's garden and gets away clean, leaving him to face an uncomfortable truth: there might be a whole world beyond his fence he's never once considered.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Golden Carrot (Part 15)
chronicles.excerpt: Digging up an old coin in the garden sends Otis into a dream where he captains a pirate ship in search of the legendary Golden Carrot, and finds his oldest rival waiting for him at the very same X.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Great Warren Expedition (Part 8)
chronicles.excerpt: Otis falls asleep under the hydrangea and wakes up leading a grand expedition across his own garden turned continent, over the Sea of the Undrained and up Mount Compostia, before opening his eyes to find how small his kingdom really is.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Guest in the House (Part 6)
chronicles.excerpt: When Katie agrees to pet-sit a friend's guinea pig, Otis has to share his prized sunny corner with a chattier, far more anxious houseguest than himself. It takes a piece of romaine lettuce to settle what territorial pacing alone could not.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Moon Made of Clover (Part 10)
chronicles.excerpt: After a heavy dinner and a long afternoon guarding the garden, Otis falls asleep and dreams his way to the moon, where he discovers, to his enormous satisfaction, that the whole surface is made of unfenced clover, the best he has ever tasted.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Night of the Owl (Part 7)
chronicles.excerpt: Otis stays out past his usual hour and finally meets a danger unlike the dog, the squirrel, or the cottontail before it: a real owl, low and silent over the grass, teaching him in under two seconds that the sky is not entirely his.

chronicles.title: Chronicles of Otis the Bunny: The Trip to Somewhere New (Part 5)
chronicles.excerpt: Katie drives Otis to a friend's backyard farm for the first time, where he meets a hen with just as much confidence about her turf as he has about his, and learns the world beyond his fence is bigger, and considerably more crowded with self-important small animals, than he thought.
